title: B4 First-Value Blind Script Acceptance Rubric

acceptancePolicy.description: A script is accepted only when an independent reviewer judges it publish-ready with minor or zero edits, no compliance violations (compliance_and_publishability >= 4), and no criterion below 3.

criteria.label: Hook Clarity
criteria.description: Whether the opening 3 to 5 seconds clearly communicate the core value or tension for the target audience.

anchors.1: No discernible hook; opens with generic filler or off-topic remarks.
anchors.2: Weak or vague opening that takes too long to signal relevance to the audience.
anchors.3: Clear topic introduction within 5 seconds, though phrasing is ordinary or mildly wordy.
anchors.4: Strong, immediate hook tailored to the audience's specific problem or desire.
anchors.5: Sharp, concrete, scroll-stopping opening that establishes stakes in the first 3 seconds.

criteria.label: Logical Structure
criteria.description: Whether the script flows coherently from hook to value/proof to CTA within the requested duration.

anchors.1: Disjointed sentences with missing transitions or broken narrative arc.
anchors.2: Partial structure but abrupt jumps, redundant beats, or poor pacing for the platform.
anchors.3: Follows a recognizable beginning-middle-end arc with minor pacing rough spots.
anchors.4: Cohesive progression from hook through product/service benefit to clear close within target duration.
anchors.5: Tightly paced, zero-fluff narrative where every scene advances comprehension and intent.

criteria.label: CTA Relevance
criteria.description: Whether the closing call to action matches the brief's required CTA and campaign objective naturally.

anchors.1: Required CTA is missing or contradicts the campaign objective.
anchors.2: CTA is present but generic, awkward, or disconnected from the preceding script.
anchors.3: Includes the required CTA accurately, though the transition feels mechanical.
anchors.4: Required CTA is clearly stated, accurate, and logically motivated by the value shown.
anchors.5: Seamless, specific, low-friction CTA that faithfully delivers the brief's required action.

criteria.label: Brand and Audience Fit
criteria.description: Whether tone, vocabulary, language, and cultural nuance fit the specified SMB brand voice and target audience.

anchors.1: Wrong language, tone, or audience register; feels misaligned with the business.
anchors.2: Noticeably off-voice (e.g., overly corporate or slang-heavy) or ignores audience context.
anchors.3: Generally appropriate language and tone with minor generic phrasing.
anchors.4: Authentic to the brand voice and relatable to the target audience in the requested language.
anchors.5: Sounds like a seasoned local operator speaking directly to their ideal customer.

criteria.label: Compliance and Publishability
criteria.description: Whether the script respects every content restriction in the brief and avoids unverified medical, financial, or deceptive claims.

anchors.1: Violates explicit content restrictions or makes deceptive/prohibited claims.
anchors.2: Borderline unsubstantiated claim or ignores a stated restriction.
anchors.3: No hard violation, but contains risky exaggeration needing careful review before posting.
anchors.4: Respects all stated restrictions and platform norms; safe to publish with minor polish.
anchors.5: Fully compliant, transparent, grounded in brief facts, and ready to publish as written.
